sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith - AKM is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Good day, mercenary. I've got another job for you. One of my regular clients is looking for an AKM fitted with a Fortis Shift foregrip, a suppressor, and a 30-round Magpul magazine. It also needs ergonomics at or above 25, combined recoil below 400, and a sighting range of at least 800. Think you can handle it? There's no rush, but I'd rather not keep the client waiting too long."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify an AKM to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.75
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Comfortable to handle, and expertly put together. Thank you. I'll let the client know their weapon is ready for pickup."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
AKM specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 400 or less recoil
- 25 or more ergonomics
- 800 or greater sighting range
- A silencer
- Fortis Shift tactical foregrip
- AK 7.62x39 Magpul PMAG 30 GEN M3 30-round magazine (Black)

sections.heading: Build
sections.text: This is one example of many possible configurations.

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard AKM from Prapor LL2.
- The Fortis Shift tactical foregrip can also be obtained through the MPX (MQB variant) barter at Mechanic LL1.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
